ctx.x: May the 24th, we did another concert at the Municipal Theatre in Casa and attraction at the Club where I played also the 25th. The 26th I went to Meknes to play with an orchestra composed of French amateur musicians who were residing in Morocco and some of them may have been born there. The president of the Hot Club whose name was Conrad Matiossek, played trumpet and he is the only one that I remember. Most of the jazz fans were Europeans in Morrocco and as they seldom ever heard many American musicians in the…

I was supposed to come back to Paris from Casablanca the 27th of May but the Air France company had a strike that day and I was obliged to stay in Casa. There was a Martinque trumpet player named Eddie Laspar whom I had known in Paris who was co-director of a club in Casa called Cabane Cubaine. Eddie asked if I would like to do a few numbers in his place that night and I accepted as I had nothing else to do. The musicians were not very up on jazz but I closed my ears as best I could to many of the things that…

The month of June '52, I did gigs in France and Belgium. Had a few also in July until the 16th when Lily and I left Paris for Chamonix, which is a summer and winter resort. It was a beautiful trip going up in the mountains on a special train for climbing mountains where the tracks seem to never stop going around and up.
